title: PhusdMinterRepoint Phase B re-seeds the V2 position with the (possibly below-par) recovered amount, no >= principal solvency floor — a pre-existing autopool shortfall is silently carried into V2
entryPointNote: UNWIRED — no npm/package.json key (same script as YS-20).
dependsOn: 6fd3eddc (YS-20) — MOOT until the ABI mismatch is fixed; the script cannot reach Phase B against the live minter today.
description: Phase B does withdrawAsOwner(minter, owner, p) then recovered = owner balance delta; if recovered < p (autopool below par) it logs a WARNING and does NOT revert (line ~258), then noMintDeposit(V2, token, recovered) re-seeds the new strategy with only the recovered (short) amount. The only post-verify on the re-seeded position is ysTV2.principalOf(token,minter) > 0 (line ~319) — there is NO require(recovered >= p) or principalOf >= prior-liability floor. So a shortfall present at migration time is migrated into the V2 position with no gate.
impact: If the old autopool is below par when (and if) YS-12 ever runs, the minter's V2-backed principal is re-seeded under its recorded phUSD liability with no abort (recovered < p is warn-only ~258; sole post-verify is principalOf > 0 ~319, no require(recovered >= p)). Any shortfall ORIGINATES in the external autopool (pre-existing, below-par at migration time), not from the script — the script's defect is the absence of a solvency floor that would abort rather than carry the shortfall forward. It neither creates nor steals value. Owner-visible via the warning. Conditional (below-par pool only) and doubly-gated: also requires YS-20 (the ABI mismatch) to be fixed first, since today the script cannot even reach Phase B against the live minter.
attackPath: 0. Gated: unreachable until YS-20 (6fd3eddc) is fixed (script reverts before Phase B against the live minter).
1. Phase B does withdrawAsOwner(minter, owner, p); recovered = balance delta.
2. If recovered < p (below-par pool) the script WARNS and continues (no revert).
3. noMintDeposit(V2, token, recovered) re-seeds V2 with the short amount; only post-check is principalOf > 0 -> under-collateralized position migrated silently.
forkEvidence:
static line-trace (script cannot execute against the live minter due to the 4-vs-7 field ABI mismatch, YS-20). recovered

0 (~319).
recommendation: Add an explicit operator-set tolerance: require(recovered >= p * minRecoveryBps / 10000) or at minimum a require that the post-reseed principalOf >= the minter's outstanding phUSD liability for that token, so a material shortfall aborts rather than silently migrates under-collateralization.
